messages:
alex: FYI customer 'CloudWave' flagged that AWS Marketplace invoices aren't mapping to their procurement entity. PO `PO-3372` shows under our org instead of customer. Can someone help? Order ID: `mp-order-0x5a9`

maria: on it — did procurement send the exact legal entity? often needs buyer account mapping on the Private Offer. Which marketplace listing (metering vs private offer)?

alex: It's a Private Offer. They expect a buyer-facing invoice with legal name 'CloudWave, Inc' and VAT exempt status. Our portal shows billed to Redwood LLC — their AP is rejecting it.

raj: tagging finance-ops @finance-ops — we need to check the billing entity tied to that private offer. If the PO was issued against our private offer but the invoice lists the wrong buyer, we can reissue but this touches revenue recognition. Any discounts or commit on the order?

olivia: commercial note: they negotiated a 20% commit discount on an annual commit. OL negotiated a private offer rate card `rw-enterprise-annual` — unsure if that persisted in the PO. Need confirmation + screenshots.

alex: They attached the PO and the AWS order email. Quick snippet from their doc: ```Order: mp-order-0x5a9
SKU: redwood-hosted-1
Qty: 100 seats
Rate: $0.02/token
Discount: 20% commit
Tax: 0% (exempt)```

maria: if tax is exempt we need their VAT/EIN on file. Often AP will accept once invoice shows their legal name + tax exemption. Raj — can finance mark invoice tax-exempt and remap entity?

raj: We can issue a corrected invoice if buyer account mapping is confirmed and we have deal desk signoff. Process is credit original invoice -> reissue. @deal-desk-bot please start approval flow. This needs exec approval for credits > $50k.

deal-desk-bot: Please complete the Private Offer Amendment form: https://redwood.workflows/po-amend. Required fields: original_order, adjusted_line_items, justification, approver. SLA: 48h for review.

olivia: I'll fill the form now. quick Q — if we reissue under CloudWave, does AWS routing/payments change? For private offers payments go through AWS and remit to us; this is just buyer-facing label, right? @finance-ops confirm.

finance-ops: Confirmed — AWS remits to Redwood. We can create a buyer-facing invoice with their legal name but must issue a credit memo for the original invoice. Accounting needs signed PO + VAT docs before we finalize.

alex: Customer needs confirmation before EOD PST or they'll hit their procurement cutoff. Can we fast-track?

olivia: If deal desk approves, I can submit the amendment + attach docs. Raj, can you scope RCM/AR steps? I'll escalate to legal if contract text needs an amendment.

raj: RCM steps: create credit memo 2025-0012, void original invoice 2025-0011, issue new invoice 2025-0013. Need approver: @kevin-deals or @cfo. Also need signed PO and VAT cert on file.

kevin-deals: I approve the reissue for legal entity correction; discount remains. Finance, proceed with credit + reissue. Olivia, please attach the PO & VAT in the amendment form.

olivia: done — submitted amendment form and attached docs. Link: https://redwood.workflows/po-amend/1751122334. @alex pls tell customer we'll reissue and expect 24–48h after docs.

alex: pinged customer: they replied 'Thanks — will upload VAT cert now'. :thumbsup:

alex: one more thing — customer asked if we can start a POC while procurement finishes. They want 10 seats for 2 weeks. Can we provision a temporary dev allocation that won't break marketplace billing?

maria: we can do a 10-seat POC license for 14 days, mark invoice $0 and tag as POC. Note: usage during POC won't reconcile to the marketplace invoice and will require manual reconciliation later.

ops: provisioned 10 seats on dev tenant `cloudwave-dev` TTL 14d. Note added: tag=POC, reconcile-flag=true.

alex: perfect — passing to customer. thanks all for the quick turn. I'll follow up if AP still rejects after reissue.
